headline: Fitch Affirms Petrobras Foreign and Local Currency Ratings at BB
summary: Fitch Ratings affirmed Petrobras's long-term foreign and local currency ratings at BB with a stable outlook, while raising its standalone credit profile.
why: Credit rating affirmations affect borrowing costs and investor risk assessments for state-backed multinational energy companies in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Petróleo Brasileiro S.A.
impacts.why: Affirmed credit ratings reflect stable corporate debt creditworthiness.
